schemaNote: corePolicy = what the LA SAYS it does. lawfulnessFlag = whether that survives scrutiny.
publishableNote: [HARD R9] An entry may only be used in a user-facing calculation or page when publishable === true, which requires a non-empty, dated policySourceUrl (and, where a lawfulnessFlag is present, a non-empty sourceUrl and decisionDate). CI enforces this.
lawfulnessNote: Sourcing a council's POLICY and sourcing an OMBUDSMAN FINDING against it are separate evidential questions, and an entry can pass one and fail the other. Where the decision itself has not been located at a citable URL, it sits in pendingLawfulnessFlag: held, never served, and invisible to the engine, which only ever reads lawfulnessFlag. That way one missing URL suppresses the allegation without also suppressing everything we do know about the council. Saying publicly that a named council acted unlawfully is precisely the claim that must never rest on an uncited note.

authorities.name: Devon County Council
authorities.corePolicy: 100% of core fostering allowance as maximum; DfE-model means test

lawfulnessFlag.summary: LGSCO 2024: blanket Child Benefit deduction from carers on means-tested benefits found unlawful. Recalculation and refunds ordered for approx. 170 carers, plus £300 + £300 remedy payments.

authorities.name: Leeds City Council
authorities.corePolicy: Does not use the DfE means-test model; individualised needs assessment

authorities.name: North Tyneside Council
authorities.corePolicy: Percentage model abolished 2018; equivalence to the maximum fostering allowance, uplifted annually in line with the National Minimum Allowance, means tested

pendingLawfulnessFlag.summary: LGSCO 17 002 928: previous fixed-percentage policy unlawful; backdating ordered.
pendingLawfulnessFlag.note: The council's current policy is sourced and published below. This finding concerns the policy North Tyneside ABOLISHED in 2018, and the decision itself has not been located at a citable URL. Held back until it is.

authorities.name: Shropshire Council
authorities.corePolicy: Special Guardianship Allowances Policy agreed by Cabinet in 2021, including backdated payments to special guardians of children who were previously looked after

authorities.name: Lincolnshire County Council
authorities.corePolicy: Uses the DfE standardised means-test model and publishes a full worked example of the calculation. Its own policy classifies that model as non-statutory guidance

authorities.name: Derby City Council
authorities.corePolicy: Allowance set at the equivalent of Derby's basic fostering rate for a child of that age
